diff --git a/serialize/json_ser.py b/serialize/json_ser.py
index 5295d64..a775c84 100644
--- a/serialize/json_ser.py
+++ b/serialize/json_ser.py
@@ -7,7 +7,10 @@ from serialize.base import Serializer
 
 class JSONSerializer(Serializer):
     def dump(self, obj) -> bytes:
-        return json.dumps(obj).encode()
+        return json.dumps(obj).encode("utf-8")
 
     def load(self, data: bytes):
-        return json.loads(data.decode("ascii"))
+        try:
+            return json.loads(data.decode("utf-8"))
+        except (UnicodeDecodeError, json.JSONDecodeError) as e:
+            raise ValueError("Invalid JSON data") from e

diff --git a/serialize/json_ser.py b/serialize/json_ser.py
index 5295d64..a2ca4a8 100644
--- a/serialize/json_ser.py
+++ b/serialize/json_ser.py
@@ -10,4 +10,9 @@ class JSONSerializer(Serializer):
         return json.dumps(obj).encode()
 
     def load(self, data: bytes):
+        if (
+            data.decode("ascii")
+            != json.dumps(self.dump(data.decode("ascii").decode("utf-8"))).encode()
+        ):
+            raise ValueError("Bytes were not produced by dump().")
         return json.loads(data.decode("ascii"))
